planned_large_comparison.source: Cs137 on cryostat lid; not the existing monoenergetic beam
planned_large_comparison.selection_rule: Measure transport/field/drift/readout time, peak memory, bytes and accepted-peak statistics; promote to100000 only within measured runtime/disk capacity with headroom. No arbitrary low-load setting if host remains responsive.
blocking_gates: Native Li response, stop flags and time/grid sensitivity characterized without forced full collection
Cryostat model imported with correct transforms/materials/overlap checks; nominal assumptions explicitly separated from as-built measurements
Versioned ion-decay adapter, finite electronics windows and Ba137m delayed-emission policy tested
Event-complete streaming/chunks; global event ledger and provenance unchanged across chunks

Numerical parcel-sampling uncertainty bounded separately from physical Fano/trapping/noise; no artificial broadening from a small weighted-parcel ensemble. Validated response lookup/kernel may be used only with quantified interpolation and timing error.

normalizations: per emitted gamma in a defined line/window
event_contract.time_policy: Retain all decay-chain times and parent links. Do not sum prompt beta and delayed daughter emissions into one minutes-long SSD waveform. Finite electronics windows link back to their parent decay.
event_contract.energy_policy: Replace the monoenergetic-gamma Edep ceiling and single-gamma-primary checks with a validated radioactive-decay energy ledger. A Cs137 ion at zero kinetic energy is not a zero-energy radiation event, and deposited energy is not universally bounded by the 662keV gamma-line energy. Track emitted radiation, recoil and escaped energy with the transport record; do not copy the existing monoenergetic validator unchanged.

comparison_stages: emitted particles and energy deposited in each material/Ge
bulk versus Li-region deposition and complete event ledger
signed induced charge, drift/collection timing and unresolved endpoint flags
preamp and shaped analog peak with independent calibration
ADC accepted/rejected/saturated counts and reconstructed energy spectrum
planned_large_comparison.storage: Single campaign-level table/container with event-complete chunks, one shared validated field solution per detector/configuration; all-event scalar summaries plus explicitly selected trace examples. Do not embed100000 full traces into the website.
